name: warpdecode_r8_weight_amortized_gate_up_contract
structure: warp owns (expert e, neuron j); group g carries (t0,t1,valid1) two tokens of expert e; weight gw/uw dequant ONCE per block, reused for both tokens; x per-token

index_contract.group: g = block_idx.z in [0, NG) ; e=GE[g], t0=GT0[g], t1=GT1[g] (valid iff GV[g]>0)
index_contract.output: Inter[GP0[g], j] and (if valid1) Inter[GP1[g], j] -- distinct pair rows, no collision (grouping is a partition of the LP pairs)

obligations.label: partition
obligations.claim: every original (token,expert) pair appears in exactly one group slot (gp0 or gp1)

obligations.label: same-expert reuse valid
obligations.claim: t0,t1 share expert e so weight (e,j) is correct for both
obligations.status: holds: 2nd token only paired when eid matches

obligations.label: correctness
obligations.claim: cosine(out, FP32 ref) ~ 1.0 for BOTH tokens

obligations.label: perf
obligations.claim: 668.6us vs per-pair R4 832us = 1.24x at B=32; 5.62 TB/s effective
